Package org.apache.juneau.marshall.toml

Class TomlWriter

java.lang.Object
java.io.Writer
org.apache.juneau.marshall.serializer.SerializerWriter<TomlWriter>
org.apache.juneau.marshall.toml.TomlWriter
All Implemented Interfaces:
Closeable, Flushable, Appendable, AutoCloseable
public class TomlWriter extends SerializerWriter<TomlWriter>
Specialized writer for serializing TOML v1.0.0.

Extends SerializerWriter with TOML-specific methods for tables, key-value pairs, and typed values.

Notes:
  • This class is not intended for external use.
